# FlowBuild AI

> FlowBuild AI is a web design and AI automation agency in Ireland, run by co-founders Liam Kieran and Paddy Meade. It designs custom websites for Irish businesses and builds the AI systems behind them: instant lead response, AI call answering, CRM and sales automation, quote follow-up, database reactivation, review requests and B2B outbound.

- Phone and WhatsApp: 085 876 4679 (+353 85 876 4679)
- Address: Enniskeen, Kingscourt, Co. Cavan, A82 RY70, Ireland
- Hours: open 24 hours
- Email: info@flowbuildai.ie
- Area served: all of Ireland
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=15357603946865523882
- Customers: local and B2B businesses, including architects, trades, barbershops, gyms, clinics, renovation companies, professional services and solar installers
- Way of working: done for you; the client owns what is built; no lock-in contract
- Client rating: 5-star average; 100% of clients satisfied

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.flowbuildai.ie/): what FlowBuild AI does, recent client websites, the AI systems, client videos, the team and common questions
- [Web Design](https://www.flowbuildai.ie/web-design/): custom website design for Irish businesses, the process from brief to go-live, portfolio, pricing approach and an enquiry form
- [AI Systems](https://www.flowbuildai.ie/ai-systems.html): the twelve AI automation systems (AI receptionist, missed-call text back, instant lead response, CRM automation, follow-up and more)
- [B2B Outbound](https://www.flowbuildai.ie/b2b-outbound.html): lead generation: outsourced SDR and cold email for B2B, plus Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad campaigns, with every lead followed up automatically
- [Scaling Roadmap](https://www.flowbuildai.ie/audit.html): free self-assessment that shows where a business is losing enquiries
- [Done-for-you AI agency vs DIY solar tools](https://www.flowbuildai.ie/solar-ai-agency-vs-diy-tools.html): comparison for Irish solar installers
